headline: Abu Dhabi's Lunate to List Humanoid Robotics ETF on ADX
summary: Abu Dhabi investment manager Lunate will list the Boreas VettaFi Humanoid Robots UCITS ETF on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange next month, tracking 41 companies across the robotics value chain.
why: Lunate is an Abu Dhabi-based alternative investment manager backed by sovereign capital, expanding thematic ETF products in the Gulf region.

impacts.name: Abu Dhabi General Index
impacts.why: Listing regional thematic ETFs expands local capital market depth and institutional product offerings.
